text: Marie au Blè was a French folkloric character. Into Christian times in Valenciennes, at the time of the ancient Celtic harvest feast of Lughnasa, a girl dressed in white was led through the streets by dancing young men. Mary of the Wheat was accompanied by an attendant who carried a white cloth upon which were displayed the first grains of harvested wheat. The festival, since abandoned, appears a late continental survival of Lughnasa.

okr.objective: Document Marie au Blè, the French folkloric character of the Lughnasa harvest feast.
